prompt: Create ONE landscape 4:3 high fidelity photographic puzzle image for an Arabic game for ages 16+. A real metal sewing-machine bobbin wound neatly with burgundy thread on pale blue sewing cloth. The bobbin fills 75% of frame. Centre shows layered thread between two perforated circular metal flanges with a centre spindle hole. Low oblique view; no needle or machine. IMPORTANT: this full image will be shown magnified 3.4x around the exact centre, leaving only approximately the central 29% visible during the question. Make that central area contain TWO coherent diagnostic material/structural details of the named object, not the entire silhouette, not blank texture, and not a disconnected fragment. Full image reveals the complete object naturally. Rich but restrained environment palette. No lettering, logos, watermark, hands, labels, borders, collages or question marks. No ivory studio background. Physical realism and fair visual evidence matter more than decoration.

review.method: Original and shipped effect at phone width, including high-tier assistance; independent editorial review.
